21位S级角色 + 18位A级角色
无50/50抽卡系统，限定池不歪
470+抽免费福利
都市大亨(City Tycoon)、房屋、载具驾驶系统

21 S-rank + 18 A-rank characters available
No 50/50 gacha — guaranteed featured character
470+ free pulls available
City Tycoon, Housing, and Vehicle Driving systems
Persona 5 collaboration — P5 music in car stereo
35M+ global pre-registrations, 6 platforms

items.descriptionEn: A-rank character, newly confirmed for launch.

items.name: 城市经营
items.description: 全新的城市经营模拟玩法，玩家可以经营自己的城市，获取丰厚奖励。通过城市经营可获得S级角色小芷。
items.descriptionEn: A brand-new city management simulation mode. Players can manage their own city and earn generous rewards. S-rank character Xiaozhi can be obtained through this mode.

items.name: 房屋系统
items.description: 全新的房屋装饰与建造系统，玩家可以自定义和装饰自己的居所。
items.descriptionEn: A new housing decoration and building system. Players can customize and decorate their own residence.

items.name: 载具驾驶
items.description: 开放世界中可驾驶各种载具自由探索，体验沉浸式城市穿梭。
items.descriptionEn: Drive various vehicles to freely explore the open world and experience immersive city traversal.

items.name: 粉色爪爪合作模式
items.description: 全新的多人合作玩法，与好友一起组队挑战。
items.descriptionEn: A new multiplayer co-op mode. Team up with friends for cooperative challenges.

items.name: 监狱系统
items.description: 全新的游戏机制，与游戏剧情和玩法深度结合。
items.descriptionEn: A new game mechanic deeply integrated with the story and gameplay.

items.name: 随身听功能
items.description: 公测新增随身听功能，可在探索时播放音乐，车载音响收录P5经典曲目。
items.descriptionEn: New Walkman feature for exploring with music. Car stereo includes Persona 5 classic tracks.

items.name: P5联动
items.description: 公测前瞻公布与《女神异闻录：夜幕魅影》联动，车载音响收录P5经典音乐。
items.descriptionEn: Collaboration with Persona 5: Phantom X announced. P5 classic music in car stereo.

items.name: 无50/50机制
items.description: 异环抽卡不设50/50机制，抽取限定角色时必定获得当期 featured 角色，无需担心歪角色。
items.descriptionEn: Neverness to Everness has no 50/50 system. When pulling for a limited character, you are guaranteed to get the featured character — no risk of losing to off-banner characters.

items.name: 新手卡池
items.description: 新手专属卡池，共20抽，可自选获得一位S级角色。
items.descriptionEn: Exclusive beginner banner with 20 pulls total. Players can select and obtain one S-rank character of their choice.

items.name: 常驻卡池自选
items.description: 常驻卡池累计抽取50次后，可自选获得一位S级角色。
items.descriptionEn: After accumulating 50 pulls on the standard banner, players can select and obtain one S-rank character of their choice.

items.name: 470+抽免费福利
items.description: 公测上线后玩家可通过各种活动、任务和邮件获取超过470次免费抽卡机会，开服即送120+抽。
items.descriptionEn: At launch, players can obtain over 470 free pulls through events, missions, and mail rewards. 120+ pulls available immediately.

items.name: 预注册奖励
items.description: 达成预注册里程碑后，所有玩家可获得丰厚预注册奖励。
items.descriptionEn: All players will receive generous pre-registration milestone rewards.

items.name: 直播兑换码
items.description: 公测前瞻直播中公布的兑换码，可在游戏内兑换奖励。
items.descriptionEn: Redeem codes revealed during the pre-launch livestream. Can be redeemed in-game for rewards.

items.name: 预下载
items.description: 预下载将于4月21日开放，玩家可提前下载游戏客户端。
items.descriptionEn: Pre-download begins April 21. Players can download the game client in advance.

items.name: PC 客户端
items.description: 支持 Windows PC 平台，公测同步上线。
items.descriptionEn: Available on Windows PC at launch.

items.name: 移动端
items.description: 支持 iOS 和 Android 平台，公测同步上线。
items.descriptionEn: Available on iOS and Android at launch.

items.name: PlayStation 5
items.description: PS5 版本与公测同步上线，支持手柄操作。
items.descriptionEn: PS5 version launches alongside all other platforms with controller support.

items.name: Mac 客户端
items.description: 支持 macOS 平台，公测同步上线。
items.descriptionEn: Available on macOS at launch.

items.name: 鸿蒙 HarmonyOS
items.description: 支持华为鸿蒙系统，公测同步上线。
items.descriptionEn: Available on Huawei HarmonyOS at launch.

highlights: 修复部分玩家无法登录的问题
优化移动端帧率表现
修复角色技能异常
修复部分任务无法完成的BUG
修复双倍经验兔子洞Bug，补偿800环石
公测致歉补偿1600环石
highlightsEn: Fixed login issues for some players
Improved mobile frame rate performance
Fixed character skill abnormalities
Fixed bugs preventing quest completion
Fixed Double EXP Rabbit Hole bug, 800 Ring Stones compensated
Launch apology compensation of 1600 Ring Stones

items.name: 登录问题修复
items.description: 修复部分玩家在特定网络环境下无法正常登录游戏的问题。
items.descriptionEn: Fixed an issue where some players could not log in under certain network conditions.

items.name: 移动端帧率优化
items.description: 优化中端手机的帧率表现，减少战斗场景掉帧。
items.descriptionEn: Optimized frame rate on mid-range phones, reducing drops during combat.

items.name: 技能动画修复
items.description: 修复部分角色技能动画卡顿和异常中断的问题。
items.descriptionEn: Fixed skill animation stuttering and abnormal interruptions for some characters.

items.name: 任务进度修复
items.description: 修复部分支线任务在特定条件下无法完成的问题。
items.descriptionEn: Fixed some side quests that could not be completed under specific conditions.

items.name: 双倍经验兔子洞Bug修复
items.nameEn: Double EXP Rabbit Hole Bug Fix
items.description: 修复了双倍经验兔子洞相关Bug，已向玩家补偿800环石。
items.descriptionEn: Fixed the Double EXP Rabbit Hole bug. 800 Ring Stones compensated to all players.

items.name: 公测致歉补偿
items.description: 针对游戏稳定性与移动端表现不足问题，项目组发布致歉公告，补偿1600环石。
items.descriptionEn: Dev team issued apology for stability and mobile performance issues. 1600 Ring Stones compensated.

compensation: 方斯x200, 环石x2400（含致歉补偿1600+兔子洞Bug补偿800）

highlights: 新角色安魂曲（Lacrimosa）— 暗属性S级限定进攻角色
新角色卡厄斯（Chaos）— 首位S级限定男角色，相属性
全新游乐园地图区域开放
船只载具系统上线
保底不歪机制：限定池保底必定UP角色
保时捷联动
版本福利：17抽 + 600体力 + 30万方斯
男角色同居社交玩法
移动端专项优化 + 剧情跳过功能
highlightsEn: New character Lacrimosa — Chaos-attribute S-rank limited Attack
New character Chaos — First limited S-rank male character, Lakshana element
New amusement park map area
Ship vehicle system
Guarantee-no-lose banner system for limited banners
Porsche collaboration
Version rewards: 17 pulls + 600 stamina + 300,000 Fons
Male character co-habitation social system
Mobile optimization + story skip feature

items.name: 安魂曲
items.description: 暗属性（Chaos）S级限定进攻角色。异常控制局ETD-4队员，在「平底锅」和「红色果冻」两种模式间切换，通过「晨光番茄酱」和「恶魔灵感」操控异能构装体进行协同攻击。核心机制为叠加「噩梦层数」后爆发高额伤害。
items.descriptionEn: Chaos-attribute S-rank limited Attack character. ETD-4 member who switches between 'frying pans' and 'red jelly' modes. Skills 'Morning Tomato' and 'Devilish Inspiration' control Esper Constructs for coordinated attacks. Core mechanic builds Nightmare Stacks then detonates for massive damage.

items.name: 卡厄斯
items.description: 异环首位S级限定男角色，相（Lakshana）属性。出现在主线「猩红研究」剧情中。
items.descriptionEn: The first limited S-rank male character in NTE. Lakshana element. Appears in the 'A Research in Scarlet' main story.

items.name: 上半卡池（安魂曲）
items.description: 5月28日 ~ 6月11日。安魂曲限定UP。
items.descriptionEn: May 28 – June 11. Lacrimosa limited banner.

items.name: 下半卡池（卡厄斯）
items.description: 6月11日 ~ 7月2日。卡厄斯限定UP。
items.descriptionEn: June 11 – July 2. Chaos limited banner.

items.name: 保底不歪机制
items.description: 1.1版本限定卡池开启「保底不歪」机制，玩家抽到保底时必定获得当期UP角色。
items.descriptionEn: Version 1.1 introduces guarantee-no-lose for limited banners — your pity pull is guaranteed to be the featured character.

items.name: 游乐园区域
items.description: 全新游乐园区域地图开放，包含新的探索点、宝箱和异象收集内容。
items.descriptionEn: A brand-new amusement park area with fresh exploration points, treasure chests, and anomaly collection content.

items.name: 船只载具
items.description: 新增船只载具系统，可在水域自由航行。
items.descriptionEn: New ship vehicle system lets you sail across water areas.

items.name: 车辆智能巡航
items.description: 车辆新增智能巡航功能。
items.descriptionEn: Vehicles get a new smart cruise control feature.

items.name: 男角色同居社交玩法
items.description: 1.1版本将上线全新的男角色同居社交玩法。
items.descriptionEn: A new co-habitation social system with male characters.

items.name: 保时捷联动
items.description: 1.1版本推出与保时捷的联动内容。
items.descriptionEn: Version 1.1 includes a collaboration with Porsche.

items.name: 版本更新福利
items.description: 版本更新福利：17抽 + 600体力 + 30万方斯。
items.descriptionEn: Version rewards: 17 pulls + 600 stamina + 300,000 Fons.

items.name: 1.1前瞻兑换码
items.description: 前瞻直播公布了3组兑换码：DREAMWALK0603、TOMATO100、RACENOLIMIT，有效期至5月25日23:59。
items.descriptionEn: 3 livestream codes released: DREAMWALK0603, TOMATO100, RACENOLIMIT. Valid until May 25 23:59.

items.name: 移动端优化
items.description: 降低发热、提升帧率稳定性、减少内存占用。
items.descriptionEn: Reduced overheating, improved frame rate stability, and lower memory usage.

items.name: 剧情跳过功能
items.description: 新增剧情跳过功能。
items.descriptionEn: New story skip feature added.

items.name: 弧盘/武器平衡性调整
items.description: 部分弧盘和武器进行了平衡性调整。
items.descriptionEn: Balance adjustments for some arc discs and weapons.

highlights: 「九百九十九夜 / 999夜」常驻桌游 RPG 奇幻模式上线 — 沃伦大陆挑战巨龙，可重复周回，也是 1.2 当前最核心的玩法入口
新角色真红（Zhenhong / Shinku）— S 级限定光系爆发主 C，龙娘，大范围 AOE 输出，是 1.2 当前最受关注的抽卡目标
新角色伊洛伊（Illica / Iroi）— 限定 S 级治疗增益辅助，全队治疗+攻击增幅+护盾，是 1.2 下一阶段高关注角色
游乐园新地图区域开放（海特洛市郊）+ GS25 便利店跨界联动
19 套新时装 + 时装染色（recolor）系统
新增卡丁车竞速小游戏、麻将新模式；深渊新增咒属性专属层
抽卡棋盘调整为 70 抽概率递增、90 抽保底 UP；免费常驻 S 级角色自选
前瞻直播福利：300 环石兑换码 + 限定滑翔翼涂装
highlightsEn: 'Nine Hundred and Ninety-Nine Nights' permanent tabletop-RPG fantasy mode launches — challenge dragons on the Warren Continent, fully repeatable
New character Zhenhong / Shinku — S-rank limited Light burst DPS, dragon girl with large-area AOE output
New character Illica / Iroi — limited S-rank Heal/Buffer with team-wide healing, ATK buffs and shields
New Amusement Park map area opens (Heitro suburbs) + GS25 convenience-store crossover collaboration
19 new outfits + outfit recolor system
New kart-racing minigame and mahjong mode; Abyss adds a Curse-attribute exclusive floor
Gacha board reworked to escalating rate from pull 70, hard pity at 90; free permanent S-rank character selector
Preview livestream rewards: 300 Ringstone redemption code + limited glider skin

items.name: 伊洛伊
items.description: S 级限定治疗增益辅助（相属性），异环当前版本的关键奶辅候选。提供全队高额治疗、攻击增幅与护盾，适配暗队、浊燃体系。下一阶段卡池重点角色。
items.descriptionEn: S-rank limited Heal/Buffer (Lakshana), one of the key sustain picks in Version 1.2. Team-wide healing, ATK buffs and shields; a major focus unit for the later phase.

items.name: 真红
items.description: S 级限定光系爆发主 C，龙娘。大范围 AOE 输出，深渊强势角色。可通过游乐园活动免费兑换专属夏日皮肤。当前卡池 UP。
items.descriptionEn: S-rank limited Light burst DPS, dragon girl. Large-area AOE, top-tier in Abyss. Free summer skin obtainable via the amusement-park event. Current featured banner.

items.name: 当前卡池（真红）
items.description: 7月8日维护后 ~ 7月29日 05:59（UTC+8）。真红限定 UP，配套专属 Arc「Blushing Mirage」同步开放。
items.descriptionEn: July 8 after maintenance – July 29, 05:59 (UTC+8). Shinku is featured, alongside her signature Arc 'Blushing Mirage'.

items.name: 下一阶段关注（伊洛伊）
items.description: 按照当前版本节奏，真红结束后伊洛伊是下一位高关注限定角色。具体开放时间以游戏内公告与后续官方日历为准。
items.descriptionEn: Based on the current patch flow, Iroi is the next high-interest limited unit after Shinku. Confirm the exact opening time through in-game notices and later official calendars.

items.name: 九百九十九夜
items.description: 全新常驻桌游 RPG 风奇幻模式，场景为沃伦大陆，可挑战巨龙、重复周回，是本版本的核心大型内容。
items.descriptionEn: New permanent tabletop-RPG-style fantasy mode set on the Warren Continent — challenge dragons, fully repeatable; the marquee content of this version.

items.name: 游乐园地图区域
items.description: 海特洛市郊全新游乐园区域开放（弗拉郎戈大道电话亭直达），含过山车、迷宫、昼夜天气切换，及游乐园专属异象委托与宝箱点位。
items.descriptionEn: New amusement-park area in the Heitro suburbs (reachable from the Frango Avenue phone booth): roller coaster, maze, day/night weather, and park-exclusive anomaly commissions and chests.

items.name: GS25 便利店联动
items.description: 地图内置 GS25 联动商店，消耗活动代币兑换限定家具、头像框、载具涂装；累计签到领配饰、10 连抽与环石礼包。
items.descriptionEn: In-map GS25 collab shop trades event tokens for limited furniture, avatar frames and vehicle skins; daily check-ins grant accessories, a 10-pull and Ringstone packs.

items.name: 卡丁车竞速 & 麻将新模式
items.description: 游乐园新增四人联机卡丁车竞速小游戏（排名奖励环石与养成材料）；麻将新增玩法模式。
items.descriptionEn: New four-player kart-racing minigame in the park (ranked rewards of Ringstones and growth mats); mahjong gains a new mode.

items.name: 抽卡机制微调
items.description: 限定棋盘 70 抽起概率递增、90 抽保底 UP 角色，武器池保底同步下调。
items.descriptionEn: Limited board: escalating rate from pull 70, guaranteed featured character by pull 90; weapon-pool pity lowered accordingly.

items.name: 深渊咒属性专属层
items.description: 深渊副本新增咒属性专属层数，真红、伊洛伊组队有通关加成，掉落新版武器突破素材。
items.descriptionEn: Abyss adds a Curse-attribute exclusive floor; Zhenhong + Illica teams get clear bonuses and drop new weapon-ascension materials.

items.name: 免费常驻 S 自选 & 老角色优化
items.nameEn: Free Permanent S Selector & Legacy Buffs
items.description: 版本发放免费常驻 S 级角色自选；娜娜莉、哈索尔攻击前摇与技能动作优化，修复多角色技能判定 BUG。
items.descriptionEn: A free permanent S-rank selector is granted; Nanali and Hathor get startup/animation improvements, plus multiple skill-hit-detection bug fixes.

items.name: 角色渲染升级
items.description: 角色光影表现与渲染效果升级，发丝细节、服装质感更加精致；优化雨天、黄昏动态环境渲染。
items.descriptionEn: Improved character lighting and rendering (hair detail, cloth texture); better rain and dusk dynamic environment rendering.

internalLinks.label: 沃伦大陆怎么进
internalLinks.labelEn: How to Unlock the Warren Continent
